metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a context and usage-limits band with compaction controls, a prompt-cache row that keeps the cache warm, the context and usage-limits rows on their own, and a catalog pane of everything the setup provides.

plugins.name: context-usage
plugins.description: context-meter and usage-limits in one band above the prompt: the context fill with its auto-compact threshold, Compact and Clear, and the 5-hour and weekly usage limits beneath it.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Prompt-cache hit rate in one row above the prompt, with how long the cache stays warm and a Keep warm switch that refreshes it while you are away.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context fill in one row above the prompt, with a switchable auto-compact threshold and Compact and Clear buttons.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: One row above the prompt: how much of the 5-hour and weekly usage limits is used, in percent, with the time until each resets.

plugins.name: catalog-pane
plugins.description: A pane that lists every skill, command, agent, mod, plugin, settings hook, MCP server and tool by category, with usage, token cost, updates and GitHub stats, and buttons to insert, run, update, disable or uninstall.
